items.exampleEn: Every participant must sign the form first.
items.exampleZh: 每位參加者都必須先在表格上簽名。

items.exampleEn: It's a safe neighborhood for children.
items.exampleZh: 這一帶對孩子來說很安全。

items.exampleEn: The museum has a resident artist who paints in the garden.
items.exampleZh: 這家博物館有一位駐館藝術家，在花園裡作畫。

items.exampleEn: Country folk are often very kind to visitors.
items.exampleZh: 鄉下人常常對遊客很親切。

items.exampleEn: Over fifty students participated in the event.
items.exampleZh: 有五十多名學生參加了這次活動。

items.exampleEn: Children should show respect to older people.
items.exampleZh: 孩子應該對長輩表示尊重。

items.exampleEn: There is a strong bond between my sister and me.
items.exampleZh: 我和姊妹之間的感情很深厚。

items.exampleEn: A household of six needs a big car.
items.exampleZh: 六口之家需要一台大車。

items.sentenceEn: Do you participate in any clubs after work?
items.sentenceZh: 你下班後有參加任何社團嗎？

items.audioEn: Our neighborhood has a small park, a bakery, and a very good school.
items.audioZh: 我們這一帶有一座小公園、一家麵包店，還有一所很好的學校。
items.questionZh: 說話者住的那一帶有什麼？
options: A big shopping mall and a cinema.
A park, a bakery, and a school.
A train station and a big hotel.

items.sentenceEn: I respect my teacher because she is always fair.
items.sentenceZh: 我尊敬我的老師，因為她總是很公平。

items.sentenceEn: In our household, everyone cooks once a week.
items.sentenceZh: 在我們家，每個人每週都要煮一次飯。

items.stemEn: The race had over two thousand ____ this year.
items.stemZh: 今年的賽跑有超過兩千名參加者。

items.stemEn: All students should ____ in class activities.
items.stemZh: 所有學生都應該參與課堂活動。

items.passageEn: Every spring, our neighborhood holds a cleaning day. Each household sends at least one person. This year, there were approximately eighty participants, from young children to old folk. The event shows respect for the place where we live, and it builds a bond between neighbors. Even the resident cat at the corner shop came to watch! Everyone who participated got a free lunch from the bakery.
items.passageZh: 每年春天，我們這一帶都會舉辦一次清潔日。每戶人家至少派一個人參加。今年大約有八十位參加者，從小孩到老人都有。這個活動表達了我們對居住環境的尊重，也建立了鄰居之間的情誼。連街角商店那隻常駐的貓都來看熱鬧！每位參加的人都拿到麵包店提供的免費午餐。

questions.questionZh: 每戶人家至少要派幾個人參加？

items.promptZh: 我們應該尊重別人的意見。
referenceEn: We should respect other people's opinions.
We should respect the opinions of others.
rubricZh: respect 可當動詞（例如 respect other people's opinions）或名詞（例如 show respect for…）
「別人的意見」可寫 other people's opinions、the opinions of others 等

items.instructionZh: 用 household 造一個句子，說說你家裡的一件事（例如家裡有幾個人、誰做家事）。
referenceEn: There are four people in my household.
In my household, my father does the cooking.
rubricZh: household 表示「一戶人家、家庭」
可用 in my household、my household has… 等
說的是自己家（例如 my household）
